sections.text_helper: Section 36.7.2 "Programming examples" in chapter 36 (Audio digital filter (ADF)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1753.
sections.section_content:
Example 1
This example describes the programming of ADF for the capture of a signal coming from a
digital microphone, using only the CIC4, with a decimation of 48, assuming that the kernel
clock is 1.536 MHz. Typically, this configuration can be used to detect sound using the SAD.
[Table 311. Programming sequence (CIC4)]
Example 2
This example describes the programming of ADF for the capture of a signal coming from a
digital microphone, using the CIC5, and the RSFLT, with a total decimation of 64.
[Table 312. Programming sequence (CIC5)]
